mentions.name: QueryPanel
mentions.description: A server-side SDK that lets an application's customers chat with their own data, built with a zero-trust architecture that can be embedded directly into web apps. It automatically scans the database schema, provides a UI to train and refine query behaviors, and stores only schema metadata — no credentials or row-level data. Already achieved strong query accuracy on a real client's ClickHouse setup and is onboarding more customers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on https://querypanel.io, a server-side SDK that lets your customers chat with their own data, designed with a zero‑trust architecture you can embed directly into your web app. It automatically scans your database schema, gives you a UI to further “train” and refine behaviors, and only stores schema metadata and no credentials or row‑level data.
